products.name: FileVault Full-Disk Encryption & Key Escrow/Recovery for macOS (Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy FileVault full-disk encryption via Intune with recovery-key escrow, rotation, SecureToken enablement, and a proven recovery workflow — data protected, Macs always recoverable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Encrypt every Mac and never lose a recovery key

FileVault protects data at rest — but only if it's enforced, escrowed, and recoverable. This solution deploys FileVault full-disk encryption via Microsoft Intune with proper recovery-key escrow, rotation, and recovery workflow, plus the SecureToken enablement that FileVault depends on — so data is protected and you can always recover a locked-out Mac, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how FileVault + SecureToken work on Apple Silicon/T2, personal vs institutional recovery keys, Intune escrow, and the recovery model.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Intune enrollment, disk-encryption policy, SecureToken/bootstrap-token, Entra groups, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to build the named FileVault disk-encryption policy, enable escrow, handle SecureToken/bootstrap token, validate key escrow, and run the recovery workflow, then pilot and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — FileVault/escrow discovery, per-device encryption + key-escrow validation, an encryption coverage/recovery-key report, safe remediation of unencrypted/unescrowed devices, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (encrypted, key escrowed, recovery works; SecureToken issues) plus Best Practices for key rotation and recovery.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every Mac encrypted with FileVault and every recovery key escrowed and recoverable — data protected at rest, no lock-outs you can't fix — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MACFV-Discovery.ps1 — tenant/device FileVault readiness for macOS (management plane, Graph)
    • MACFV-Remediation.ps1 — safely re-apply the FileVault policy to unencrypted/unescrowed Macs (management plane, Graph)
    • MACFV-Report.ps1 — fleet FileVault encryption + escrow coverage, and personal recovery-key retrieval (Graph)
    • MACFV-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/adjust FileVault pilot or production group membership, preview-first (-WhatIf)
    • MACFV-Validation.ps1 — per-device FileVault encryption + key-escrow check (management plane, Graph)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
